answer: Propose sponsored relay IDs for orchard soil, vine stress and reef oxygen alarms. Each ID reserves 20 tokens from its sponsor's bond for seven days. Validators check disjoint reserves and inject fresh ID-bound alarms; no receipt at their test client within 60 seconds suspends the ID and transfers its reserve to a customer pool. Tests do not prove sensor truth or delivery of untested alerts. Hardware is reusable; power recurs; unslashed stake returns, so its cost is illiquidity. A 200-token bond funds at most ten concurrent IDs; pooled servers and parallel tests cannot reuse reserves.
